case_studies.headline: A website and social presence for a market data company that's been around since 1984
case_studies.summary: TraderMade sells market data APIs to two very different audiences: developers who want to try an API in five minutes, and data teams at banks who need to get procurement to sign off. We built the website and manage their social media.
case_studies.challenge: The site had to work for both audiences at once. Developers look for docs, pricing and a free key. Enterprise buyers look for coverage, reliability and who else uses the data. It also had to explain clearly what TraderMade does, so search engines and AI tools describe it correctly.
work: Answer-first product and documentation-led content structure
Structured data and technical SEO foundations
Ongoing social media management and content

highlights.label: Founded, so four decades of heritage to get across
We built the site and run the social media

case_studies.short: Real-time and historical FX, crypto and CFD data for banks, fintechs and developers since 1984. We built the website and run their social media.

case_studies.headline: A 45-page rebuild that keeps every old address working
case_studies.summary: Kingfisher House rents serviced offices, meeting rooms and virtual office services in Bromley. The old website was dated and hard for the team to update. We redesigned and rebuilt it so their own team can change the wording without breaking anything.
case_studies.challenge: The old site had years of pages and blog posts indexed by Google. Changing the addresses would have thrown that away. The team also needed to edit copy themselves, which on the old site meant waiting for a developer.
work: Redesign and rebuild of 45 pages, including every blog post brought across word for word
Every old address kept or redirected, 23 redirects in total
All wording kept in simple files the team can edit, checked automatically before each update goes live
A private staging site for reviewing changes, hidden from Google
Structured data for the business, its services and FAQs
case_studies.short: A business centre in Bromley. We rebuilt their 45-page website, blog included, and kept every old address working, so nothing indexed was lost.
